sentences.text: Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas" aims to provide financial assistance to Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh, who secured admission for any master's degree course overseas in reputed institutions for the year or students pursuing part of their course abroad.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: International education
**Where it applies:** Andhra Pradesh; State/ UT

**Detailed Description:** Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation (ABC), a Government of Andhra Pradesh undertaking, is introducing the “Bharati Scheme for Master’s Degree Overseas” (BS-MDO) for the year 2019-20, for the Brahmin students of Andhra Pradesh. Under this scheme, a specified amount shall be released to the selected applicants, as one-time financial assistance. This scheme is applicable to students of Andhra Pradesh covering all 13 districts.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - Any course being pursued abroad with a duration of 11 to 18 months: ₹5,00,000/-. - Master’s Degree Programme being pursued abroad with a minimum of 18 months duration: ₹10,00,000/-.

**Application Process:** > **Registration** **Step-01:** Applicants have to visit the [official website](https://www.andhrabrahmin.ap.gov.in/) and click on [Scheme](https://www.andhrabrahmin.ap.gov.in/schemes/schemes.aspx#). **Step-02:** Click on "Registration" under the concerned scheme name. **Step-03:** Fill out the application form with required details like: - Personal Details: Name, Residence address, Aadhaar no, Ration card no, Bank detail etc - Upload: Photo, Signature and Certificate Details - Documents: Birth Certificate, Residential Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Caste Certificate, Bank Passbook etc - Finalize and "Submit" the application. **Step-04:** Receive the reference number after the submission.  > **Check Application Status:** **Step-01:** Click on the “Services” link on the menu and select "[Know your status](https://www.andhrabrahmin.ap.gov.in/eSchemes/know_stat.aspx)". **Step-02:** Enter the Reference or Mobile or Aadhaar Card Number to get the application status. **Step-03:** Select the "Financial Year&quot
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Andhra Pradesh Brahmin Welfare Corporation
